title: Uniaxial Cube Elastic Compression
description: Single 8-node hexahedral solid steel cube subjected to uniaxial compressive nodal force with full bottom-face SPC constraints and explicit central-difference time integration.

title: Cantilever Beam Transverse Impact Transient
description: Four-element Euler-Bernoulli steel cantilever beam subjected to a triangular tip impulse load with clamped root SPC boundary conditions and explicit transient response.

title: Taylor Bar Elasto-Plastic Axial Impact
description: Classic OFHC copper Taylor cylinder impact benchmark modeled with MAT_PIECEWISE_LINEAR_PLASTICITY, initial axial velocity, and rigid anvil SPC boundary constraints.

title: Automotive Crash Box Axial Crush
description: Thin-walled DP600 dual-phase steel automotive front crash box modeled with Belytschko-Tsay shell elements, elasto-plastic hardening, rigid barrier SPC constraints, and modular mesh/material include decks.

title: Three-Point Bending Composite Beam with Rigid Impactor
description: Multi-part explicit three-point bending assembly combining a deformable composite beam, rigid cylindrical striker, roller support SPCs, load curve, and modular include files for mesh, impactor, and material properties.
